name: ScholarshipMatcher
tagline: Personalised scholarship matching, shortlist and application tracking for student portals
description: Matches each student's profile against scholarship eligibility rules, scores every award 0-100 % with a plain-language explanation, highlights deadlines and lets students shortlist awards and track applications - saved to a single Dataverse column. Works in Power Pages, Model-driven and Canvas apps.
features: Eligibility engine: level, residency, enrolment, GPA, income, required groups and fields
Eligible / Nearly eligible / Not eligible / Closed with reasons
Search, eligibility segment, award-type chips, four sort orders
Application status and requirements checklist per award
Phone bottom sheet and sticky shortlist bar
Read-only advisor view, loading, empty and invalid-data states
